model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: toyota.com '2027 Toyota bZ Specifications', 'Overall length: 184.6', identical across all five grades in the page's embedded spec data.

width_in.note: 'Overall width: 73.2', all grades; mirrors not stated. C/D lists the same figure as width without mirrors, and its twin the Subaru Solterra lists 73.2 in.

awd.label: XLE, Limited
awd.note: toyota.com: 'bZ's available AWD capability'; 'a 288-mile EPA-estimated range rating on XLE AWD'. Limited AWD from C/D's 2026 trim list.

charge_port.note: 'NACS Charging Port: bZ is equipped with a North American Charging System (NACS) charging port'.

supercharger_access.note: 'bZ is equipped with a North American Charging System (NACS) charging port and includes separate CCS1 and J1772 adapters ... With access to a growing network of public chargers, including the Tesla Supercharger Network'.

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Toyota among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'For new vehicles that are NACS-equipped, no adapter will be necessary.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: toyota.com '2027 Toyota bZ' with starting MSRP; the page also links the 2026 bZ. pressroom.toyota.com returned a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403).

epa_range.note: EPA has no 2027 bZ yet (sources/fe-menu-model-2027-toyota.xml), so these are EPA's 2026 listings. toyota.com's 2027 page states the same AWD figure: 'a 288-mile EPA-estimated range rating on XLE AWD'. FWD entries carry EPA's own labels; they weren't mapped to Toyota's trims. Excludes the bZ Woodland (50305, 50306), a separate model outside this universe.

cargo_cu_ft.note: C/D 2026 XLE Plus FWD (Natl), cargo space behind the second row and behind the front row.

turning_circle_ft.note: C/D 2026 XLE Plus FWD (Natl), 'Turning Diameter / Radius, curb to curb (feet)'.
